en.plugins.tts.desc: Convert a text to a voice note (language auto-detected)
en.plugins.tts.usage:
{0}tts <text>
{0}tts {lang} <text>
Or reply to a text message with {0}tts.

Examples:
• {0}tts Hello World
• {0}tts {es} Hola Mundo
• {0}tts {fr} Bonjour

The language is detected automatically unless you give it between braces. Maximum {1} characters.

Popular languages:
en - English
es - Spanish
fr - French
de - German
it - Italian
pt - Portuguese
hi - Hindi
ja - Japanese
ko - Korean
ar - Arabic
en.plugins.tts.empty_text: ❌ Please give the text to convert after the language code.
en.plugins.tts.invalid_lang:
❌ Invalid language code: {0}

Use standard ISO codes such as en, es, fr.
en.plugins.tts.error: ❌ Text-to-speech failed. Please try again with a shorter text or another language.
